stem:
Ishaan's leftover cooked rice smells sour after three days and cannot be eaten. At home, his family also sets curd from milk on purpose.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The souring of the leftover rice is undesirable, because the rice was meant to be eaten later.
Souring of milk is always undesirable, so setting curd from milk is also undesirable.
The souring of the leftover rice is desirable, because every change in food is useful.
Setting curd and spoiling rice cannot be judged, because both involve souring.

teacher.key_rationale: Desirable or undesirable depends on situation and purpose: spoiled leftover rice is unwanted, while setting curd is useful. Treating all souring as bad drops the situation; calling spoilage desirable reverses the judgment.
